name: arc-xray
description: Read-only, source-backed architecture audits with interactive maps, execution sketches, editable diagrams and evidence-based review.

interface.longDescription: Independent source-backed architecture review with one canonical blue interactive atlas in Chat and Work. No MCP server or connector required. Includes a self-contained skill runtime, index.html, source evidence, five-area completion gate, risks, logs, draw.io and Mermaid. Source access and a host Python/file environment are required; unsupported environments are reported explicitly.
defaultPrompt: Create a read-only architecture atlas for this project.
Review architectural risks and connect each observation to source evidence.
